lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in a repeating grid pattern on the mid-lateral flank, forming at least three distinct vertical columns of 3 to 4 spots each.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of spots, creating a rectilinear lattice pattern across the central flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature is visible along the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp intensity gradient transition from high-luminance dorsal pixels to shadowed lateral pixels.

other_distinctive_markers: Dense patterning of small high-luminance blobs is visible on the dorsal surface of the pectoral fin, concentrated toward the anterior margin.
